confirmedRuntimeDefects.rootCause: Incoming damage rounds absolute HP upward, but confirmedFocusSash checked raw HP percent >=100. Fractional storage encoding near 100% therefore disagreed with the outgoing calculator and PS Damage event.
confirmedRuntimeDefects.fix: Evaluate known active Focus Sash against the same absolute fullHpAtHit condition used by incoming damage and Sturdy. No stat or raw damage change.
confirmedRuntimeDefects.regression: browser_ko_boundary_test.py: sash/incoming full-HP integer boundary and chipped states

fixtureCorrections: HP=0 targets were excluded because fainted Pokemon are not legal targets and spread victim count changes; no product fix made for that invalid fixture.

Outgoing Foul Play uses the existing explicit neutral/uninvested opponent Attack prior independently of the selected defensive bulk preset; the independent oracle now models that documented assumption.
Immunity branches expose no KO probability property; the harness explicitly normalizes their zero damage to zero KO probability and rejects non-finite ordinary KO probabilities.
